metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the stdlib-only Rust `ical` CLI in [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) with entry point [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs).

Verified:

```bash
cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml
```

The release binary supports both required `parse` and `expand` subcommands.

    def test_calendar_image_display_values_comma_list(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """RFC 7986 §6.1 allows the DISPLAY parameter to carry multiple values
        (comma-separated): `DISPLAY=BADGE,THUMBNAIL`. The entire DISPLAY string
        should be surfaced; we accept either the raw joined string or a semantic
        split (depending on harness preference)."""
        out = run_parse(
            submission_command,
            _wrap_calprops(
                "IMAGE;VALUE=URI;DISPLAY=BADGE,THUMBNAIL;FMTTYPE=image/png:"
                "https://example.com/weather-cloudy.png\n"
            ),
            tmp_path,
        )
        images = _dict_list_field(_cal(out), "images")
        assert len(images) == 1
        display = cast(str, images[0].get("display") or "")

    def test_dst_spring_forward_gap_uses_rfc_pre_transition_offset(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        # 2026-03-08 DST starts at 02:00 local (EST → EDT). Local time 02:30 does
        # NOT exist in the wall clock. RFC 5545 §3.3.5 requires the offset BEFORE
        # the gap (-0500). The summary's §5.1.1 says post-transition, but both the
        # base prompt and summary opening explicitly give the RFC precedence.
        # Correct the hidden expectation without changing any public input.
        body = "UID:e1\nDTSTAMP:20260101T120000Z\nDTSTART;TZID=America/New_York:20260308T023000\n"
        out = run_expand(
            submission_command,
            _wrap_tz(body),
            "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z",
            "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z",
            tmp_path,
        )
        assert len(out["occurrences"]) == 1

submission_command = ('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/ical-build0/build/release/ical',)
tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_rscale_chinese_either_exp0')

    def test_rscale_chinese_either_expand_or_unsupported_warning(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """RFC 7529 §4.3.1 example: `DTSTART=20130210;RRULE=RSCALE=CHINESE;
        FREQ=YEARLY` represents Chinese New Year. A conforming implementation MAY
        either expand correctly to the RFC 7529 table (20130210, 20140131, 20150219,
        20160208, 20170128) OR emit `rscale_unsupported` and preserve the RRULE in
        raw_properties."""
        body = (
            "UID:cny\nDTSTAMP:20130101T120000Z\nDTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20130210\n"
            "RRULE:RSCALE=CHINESE;FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=5\n"
        )
        ics = wrap_event(body)
        expand_out = run_expand(
            submission_command, ics, "2013-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2018-01-01T00:00:00Z", tmp_path
        )
        kinds = [w.get("kind") for w in warnings_of(expand_out)]
        starts = starts_for(expand_out.get("occurrences") or [], "cny")
        if "rscale_unsupported" in kinds:
            # Fallback path: RRULE must be preserved in raw_properties.
            parsed = run_parse(submission_command, ics, tmp_path)
            ev = find_event(parsed, "cny")
            raw = _raw_rrule(ev) or ""
>           assert "RSCALE=CHINESE" in raw
E           AssertionError: assert 'RSCALE=CHINESE' in ''

editorial.last_message: Claims implemented and build-verified Rust parse/expand CLI; completes voluntarily at frozen 454/467. Edge validation, timezone and data-retention defects remain alongside documented raw-property representation caveats; no score adjustment.
editorial.notes: All13 failures independently reviewed: six clear semantic observations (IMAGE DISPLAY truncation, CANCEL STATUS/ADD RECURRENCE-ID constraints, two gap-offset conversions, reversed RDATE PERIOD); three unsupported-RSCALE raw-retention assertions; four known VALARM raw-duplication assertions. Chinese/Islamic RSCALE values remain typed, and their required duplicate raw location is not explicit; Hebrew also genuinely loses the BYMONTH=5L leap marker. Typed alarm values are preserved. Document these representation limitations for the future contract fix without pausing or changing frozen scoring, per user direction; see docs/validation/non-rs274-2026-09-12/ical-valarm-publication-hold.md. 133 exact tools =66 canonical commands+64 file changes+3 pre-item patch rejections; rejected duplicate-target/context-miss edits are not infrastructure faults. Final canonical/session token totals reconcile, recorded-rate cost $6.575509. Network156 API-only allows and10 denied startup assets, no successful external acquisition, apps/web disabled. Build and interface claims supported, remaining gaps unacknowledged. Normal completion with immutable raw evidence and local/source image distinction preserved; CLI0.153.4 and frozen inputs unchanged.
